description: A richtext facet feature mentioning a Pokémon TCG card. SwapPulse-aware clients render this as a rich card chip; other clients ignore the feature and show the surrounding text.

main.description: A facet feature referencing a TCGDex card within an app.bsky.feed.post record.

cardId.description: TCGDex card id of the mentioned card.

cardName.description: Display name of the mentioned card.

cardUri.description: SwapPulse card page URL (https://swappulse.org/card/<cardId>) or at:// URI for the card record.
